data.title: 五更琉璃 · 客厅榻榻米的同人Galgame测试
data.description: 五更家温馨的榻榻米客厅上，并肩坐在笔记本电脑前测试自制恋爱游戏。屏幕上跳出心动告白CG的瞬间，黑猫整张脸通红，假装咳嗽却偷偷偏头打量你的侧颜。
data.location: cozy traditional tatami living room with Kotatsu and manga stacks
data.action: sitting side by side on living room tatami playing a romance visual novel on laptop, blushing furiously as an intimate scene appears, peeking at partner profile
data.lighting: soft afternoon daylight through shoji sliding doors
data.mood: nerdy sweet awkwardness, heart-pounding proximity, adorable tsundere tension
data.promptProse: Sitting side by side on living room tatami before a laptop, Ruri Gokou blushes furiously at a romance game, peeking at partner with lovely blue eyes.
data.animaCaption: Ruri Gokou blushing while testing romance visual novel on tatami.
